What Life Was Like in Medieval Venice | History for Sleep

About 1 hour 52 min · Released Thu 19 Nov 2026 · Updated 22 Nov 2026 · narrated slowly for sleep

Watch on YouTube Listen on YouTube Music

A Night in Venice history for sleep: water-steps, gondolas and the dark lagoon of the Venetian Republic after nightfall, around 1600

After dark, Venice was a city of water-streets with little fixed light: you carried a flame, or you knew the channel, or you waited. A lamp, around the year 1600, was something you brought with you. Tonight, I'll walk with you from the water-steps, and we'll go out on the lagoon and back.

🌙 No mid-video ads, nothing to wake you.

The regulations, the boat types and the work of the water are real. The passenger we follow tonight is imagined.

About this sleep story

About 1 hour 52 min, narrated slowly for sleep, with no ad breaks. Made as history to fall asleep to: it's fine to drift off partway, and the chapters below let you find your place again.

One evening in Venice around the year 1600: from the water-steps along the canals, out onto the lagoon, and back to a quiet room at the end of the water.

Sources

Researched and written for this channel from these sources. Where historians disagree, the narration says so.

  • University of Glasgow (Wilson and Favotto), From seedlings to ships: the Venice Arsenale, 1400-1800, read 14 November 2026 https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/294294/1/294294.pdf
  • Hakai Magazine (Barbara Beltramello), The Gondola Maker, read 14 November 2026 https://hakaimagazine.com/videos-visuals/gondola-maker/
  • Laura Morelli, Historical Sources for the Venetian Gondola, read 14 November 2026 https://lauramorelli.com/historical-sources-venetian-gondola/
  • National Geographic (Kasia Dietz, with historian Filippo de Vivo), How Renaissance-era Venetians complained, read 14 November 2026 https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/need-to-complain-heres-how-renaissance-era-venetians-did-it
  • Italgas HeritageLab, history of public lighting in Venice, read 14 November 2026 https://heritagelab.italgas.it/storia/i-bagliori-delle-luci-di-venezia/
  • Basilica di San Marco, The Bells, read 14 November 2026 https://www.basilicasanmarco.it/en/bell-tower/the-bells/
